summary: Audax Private Credit Fund, LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events solely to disclose its net asset value per share as of May 31, 2026, which was $24.962 per common share. The filing provided supplementary portfolio metrics: aggregate NAV of $572.4 million, investment portfolio fair value of $1.081 billion, principal debt outstanding of $550.4 million, and a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 0.96x. This is a routine periodic NAV disclosure with no corporate action, transaction, or structural change. There are no stated terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics typical of a special situation. This is purely an informational update.
